verdict.rationale: Subscription migration and PCI-compliant card data import are fair questions for a billing and invoicing product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents importing subscriptions from a spreadsheet or competing platform, or transferring card data. The only portability evidence is CSV export of invoices, which goes outbound and does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing
